sophia.g: Heads-up: pen-test vendor (SentinelSec) confirmed Tue Apr 9 09:00 PT. Need a short checklist: RBAC changes, KMS access window, evidence export path. Who can own?

raj.n: I can own RBAC changes. Need exact role names and a timebox.

emily.l: I can do KMS access & presigned evidence path. Prefer ephemeral roles not permanent creds.

tyler_sre: +1 on ephemeral. Also we need a small runbook for the role-swap and rollback steps. Can someone draft?

sophia.g: @raj.n please prepare a diff of IAM roles we'll change. Keep it timeboxed: 09:00-13:00 PT. Revert at 13:15 unless retest extends.

raj.n: Drafted a diff and minimal perms list -> https://gist.github.com/xxxxx :eyes: Will include explicit ARNs and the revert block.

emily.l: KMS plan: create ephemeral key-wrap role via vault-kms-proxy with short TTL. Test decrypt on staging. Proposed commands:
```bash
# issue ephemeral token
vault token create -policy=pen-test-evidence -ttl=4h
# test decrypt (staging)
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://sample.enc --output text\```
We won't rotate customer primary keys; proxy-scoped keys only.

tyler_sre: Add log-export commands for CloudWatch/ELK — assessor will request request/response traces. Keep sampling minimal to avoid PII.

emily.l: Adding export command we'll use:
```bash
# export filtered logs to S3 for evidence
aws logs create-export-task --task-name pen-test-evidence --log-group-name /redwood/inference --from 1710000000000 --to 1710003600000 --destination s3://pt-evidence-bucket\```
I'll run a scrub step before upload.

sophia.g: Also schedule a retest slot: Thu Apr 11 10:00 PT in case vendor requests follow-up. @tyler_sre can you reserve?

tyler_sre: Reserved retest slot and added runbook section in ops docs. :white_check_mark:

raj.n: Quick question — will vendors auth via our SSO or get pre-created accounts?

sophia.g: Prefer SSO + ephemeral roles via SCIM/IdP. If they need static creds we'll sandbox and expire after window. Document the justification.

oncall-bot: Reminder: created incident channel #pt-1822468100 for evidence and real-time comms (auto-created).

emily.l: I'll run a staging KMS dry-run today 15:00 PT and post pass/fail + sample manifest here.

sophia.g: Perfect — post results and a sample log manifest. Once vendor report arrives we'll create the remediation tracker with owner, priority, ETA, verification steps and retest slot mapping.

(threads tend to be short; followups will be new threads for remediation items)
